from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Extracted evidence from a single judgment document for outcome matching."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    procedure_stage: str = Field(description="The procedural stage, e.g., '二审', '再审审查', '提审'")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The cause of action, e.g., '遗赠纠纷', '共有权确认纠纷'")
    parties_involved: list[str] = Field(description="List of named parties in the document")
    court_cost_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total court cost amount if specified (e.g., 8200.0)")
    cost_bearers: list[str] = Field(description="Names of parties bearing the court costs")
    ruling_disposition: str = Field(description="Short description of the final ruling (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    ruling_verbatim: str = Field(description="Verbatim snippet of the final ruling order")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentEvidence]
